config.prompt: Asigná todas las acciones siguientes a margarita@startti.ai (buscá su owner id una vez y reusalo). En el deal 'Dummy Corp QA — POC inicial' (que creamos antes): (1) agregá una nota como Margarita: 'Cliente pidió 10% de descuento; ofrecí 5%, pendiente respuesta del comité'. Asociala al deal y al contacto Juan Perez. (2) Creá una tarea de llamada con due date 2026-05-09T15:00:00Z, prioridad alta, subject 'Llamar a Juan para cerrar tema descuento', asociada al deal y al contacto, asignada a Margarita. (3) Juan reportó un bug crítico: 'No puedo subir archivos al portal — recibo error 500 al confirmar'. Creá un ticket en alta prioridad asignado a Margarita, asociado al contacto y a la empresa Dummy Corp QA. Recordá llamar list_ticket_pipelines primero para obtener pipeline/stage válidos.

config.system_message: You manage HubSpot CRM contacts and companies. Before creating or enriching a record, you may use the `web` tool to research the company online (industry, domain, headquarters, description) to avoid guessing or asking the user for things you can find. When you need details about a specific HubSpot operation, load the matching reference from the hubspot-crm skill.

list_contacts.name: list_contacts
list_contacts.description: List HubSpot contacts (paginated, no filters). Use this to browse what's there. For filtered queries use `search_contacts`. See `hubspot-crm/list_contacts`.

after.description: Pagination cursor from a prior response's paging.next.after. Omit on first page.

properties.description: Comma-separated property names to return, e.g. 'email,firstname,lastname'.

archived.description: If true, list archived (soft-deleted) records. Default false.

create_contact.name: create_contact
create_contact.description: Create a HubSpot contact. Provide a `properties` object with at least `email`. See `hubspot-crm/create_contact` for valid property names and dedup behavior.

properties.description: Contact fields. Required: email. Common: firstname, lastname, phone, company, lifecyclestage. See hubspot-crm/create_contact for the full property list.

update_contact.name: update_contact
update_contact.description: Update a HubSpot contact's properties. Requires the contact id in the endpoint path. See `hubspot-crm/update_contact`.

endpoint.description: Full path of the form /crm/v3/objects/contacts/{contactId} where {contactId} is the real id from a prior search_contacts or create_contact response. Never invent an id.

properties.description: Properties to update (partial). Same names as create_contact. See hubspot-crm/update_contact.

search_contacts.name: search_contacts
search_contacts.description: Search HubSpot contacts using filterGroups. Use this before update or associate when you only have an email/name. See `hubspot-crm/search_contacts` for the body shape and operators.

body.description: Full JSON body. Required: filterGroups (array of { filters: [ { propertyName, operator, value } ] }). Optional: properties (array of strings — names to return), limit (number, default 10, max 100). Operators: EQ, NEQ, CONTAINS_TOKEN, HAS_PROPERTY, NOT_HAS_PROPERTY, GT, LT, BETWEEN, IN. See hubspot-crm/search_contacts.

list_companies.name: list_companies
list_companies.description: List HubSpot companies (paginated, no filters). Use this to browse what's there. For filtered queries use `search_companies`. See `hubspot-crm/list_companies`.

after.description: Pagination cursor from a prior response's paging.next.after. Omit on first page.

properties.description: Comma-separated property names to return, e.g. 'name,domain,industry'.

archived.description: If true, list archived (soft-deleted) records. Default false.

create_company.name: create_company
create_company.description: Create a HubSpot company. Provide a `properties` object with at least `name`. See `hubspot-crm/create_company` for valid property names and dedup notes.

properties.description: Company fields. Required: name. Common: domain, industry, phone, city, country, numberofemployees. See hubspot-crm/create_company.

update_company.name: update_company
update_company.description: Update a HubSpot company's properties. Requires the company id in the endpoint path. See `hubspot-crm/update_company`.

endpoint.description: Full path of the form /crm/v3/objects/companies/{companyId} where {companyId} is the real id from a prior search_companies or create_company response. Never invent an id.

properties.description: Properties to update (partial). Same names as create_company. See hubspot-crm/update_company.

search_companies.name: search_companies
search_companies.description: Search HubSpot companies using filterGroups. Use this before update or associate when you only have a domain/name. See `hubspot-crm/search_companies` for the body shape and operators.

body.description: Full JSON body. Required: filterGroups (array of { filters: [ { propertyName, operator, value } ] }). Optional: properties (array of strings — names to return), limit (number, default 10, max 100). Operators: EQ, NEQ, CONTAINS_TOKEN, HAS_PROPERTY, NOT_HAS_PROPERTY, GT, LT, BETWEEN, IN. See hubspot-crm/search_companies.

list_deals.name: list_deals
list_deals.description: List HubSpot deals (paginated, no filters). Use to browse what's there. For filtered queries use `search_deals`. See `hubspot-crm/list_deals`.

after.description: Pagination cursor from a prior response's paging.next.after. Omit on first page.

properties.description: Comma-separated property names to return, e.g. 'dealname,amount,dealstage,closedate'.

archived.description: If true, list archived (soft-deleted) records. Default false.

create_deal.name: create_deal
create_deal.description: Create a HubSpot deal. Provide a `properties` object with at least `dealname`. Look up valid `pipeline`/`dealstage` ids via `list_pipelines` first, and `hubspot_owner_id` via `list_owners` if you set it. See `hubspot-crm/create_deal`.

properties.description: Deal fields. Required: dealname. Common: pipeline, dealstage (must belong to the chosen pipeline), amount, closedate (ISO 8601), hubspot_owner_id, description, dealtype. See hubspot-crm/create_deal.

update_deal.name: update_deal
update_deal.description: Update a HubSpot deal's properties (move stage, change amount, reassign owner). Requires the deal id in the endpoint path. See `hubspot-crm/update_deal`.

endpoint.description: Full path of the form /crm/v3/objects/deals/{dealId} where {dealId} is the real id from a prior search_deals, list_deals, or create_deal response. Never invent an id.

properties.description: Properties to update (partial). Same names as create_deal. See hubspot-crm/update_deal.

search_deals.name: search_deals
search_deals.description: Search HubSpot deals using filterGroups. Use this before update or associate when you only have a name/criteria. See `hubspot-crm/search_deals` for the body shape and operators.

body.description: Full JSON body. Required: filterGroups (array of { filters: [ { propertyName, operator, value } ] }). Optional: properties (array of strings — names to return), limit (number, default 10, max 100). Operators: EQ, NEQ, CONTAINS_TOKEN, HAS_PROPERTY, NOT_HAS_PROPERTY, GT, LT, BETWEEN, IN. See hubspot-crm/search_deals.

list_pipelines.name: list_pipelines
list_pipelines.description: List HubSpot deal pipelines and their stage IDs. Call this BEFORE create_deal/update_deal so you do not invent pipeline or dealstage values. See `hubspot-crm/list_pipelines`.

list_owners.name: list_owners
list_owners.description: List HubSpot owners (workspace users). Call before assigning hubspot_owner_id on contacts/companies/deals. Filter by email to find a specific user. See `hubspot-crm/list_owners`.

after.description: Pagination cursor from paging.next.after. Omit on first page.

email.description: Exact-match filter on user email — useful to find one specific person's owner id.

archived.description: If true, include deactivated users. Default false.

web.name: web
web.description: Web search and fetch via Tavily. Use to discover a company's industry, domain, headquarters, description, or any public info before creating/enriching its HubSpot record. Sub-tools: `search` (general queries) and `fetch` (extract content from a specific URL).

associate_contact_company.name: associate_contact_company
associate_contact_company.description: Associate a HubSpot contact with a HubSpot company using the default (primary) association type. Both ids must come from prior search/create — never invent. See `hubspot-crm/associate_contact_company`.

endpoint.description: Full path of the form /crm/v4/objects/contact/{contactId}/associations/default/company/{companyId}. Both ids required. The 'default' segment means HubSpot's primary association type; body is empty.

associate_deal.name: associate_deal
associate_deal.description: Link a HubSpot deal to a contact OR a company using the default (primary) association type. Call once per direction (one call to link the deal to a contact, another to link it to a company). Both ids must come from prior search/create — never invent. See `hubspot-crm/associate_deal`.

endpoint.description: Full path of the form /crm/v4/objects/deal/{dealId}/associations/default/{contact|company}/{toId}. Pick `contact` or `company` for the second-to-last segment based on what you are linking. Body is empty.

add_note.name: add_note
add_note.description: Log a note on the timeline of a contact, company, deal, or ticket. Use to leave a footprint of what happened. See `hubspot-crm/add_note` for the body shape (properties + inline associations).

body.description: Full JSON body. Required: properties.hs_note_body (string) and properties.hs_timestamp (ISO 8601). Recommended: associations array with entries { to: { id }, types: [{ associationCategory: 'HUBSPOT_DEFINED', associationTypeId: <int> }] }. AssociationTypeIds: 202=contact, 190=company, 214=deal, 228=ticket. See hubspot-crm/add_note.

create_task.name: create_task
create_task.description: Create a HubSpot to-do (CALL/EMAIL/TODO) with a due date and assignee. Look up `hubspot_owner_id` via `list_owners` first. See `hubspot-crm/create_task` for the body shape.

body.description: Full JSON body. Required properties: hs_task_subject (string), hs_timestamp (ISO 8601 due date). Optional: hs_task_body, hs_task_status (NOT_STARTED|IN_PROGRESS|WAITING|COMPLETED|DEFERRED), hs_task_priority (LOW|MEDIUM|HIGH), hs_task_type (TODO|CALL|EMAIL), hubspot_owner_id. Recommended: associations with associationTypeIds 204=contact, 192=company, 216=deal, 230=ticket. See hubspot-crm/create_task.

list_ticket_pipelines.name: list_ticket_pipelines
list_ticket_pipelines.description: List HubSpot ticket pipelines and their stage IDs. Call this BEFORE create_ticket so you do not invent hs_pipeline or hs_pipeline_stage values. Ticket pipelines are separate from deal pipelines. See `hubspot-crm/list_ticket_pipelines`.

create_ticket.name: create_ticket
create_ticket.description: Log a customer support issue or message as a HubSpot ticket. Call list_ticket_pipelines first to get valid pipeline/stage ids. See `hubspot-crm/create_ticket` for the body shape.

body.description: Full JSON body. Required by HubSpot: properties.subject (string) AND properties.hs_pipeline_stage (stage id from list_ticket_pipelines — call it first). Recommended: properties.content, hs_pipeline (default '0'), hs_ticket_priority (LOW|MEDIUM|HIGH), hs_ticket_category, source_type (CHAT|EMAIL|FORM|PHONE), hubspot_owner_id. Recommended: associations with associationTypeIds 16=contact, 26=company, 28=deal. See hubspot-crm/create_ticket.
